items.exampleEn: Only a minority of students failed the test.
items.exampleZh: 只有少數學生考試不及格。

items.exampleEn: The success of the event was largely due to good weather.
items.exampleZh: 活動成功主要是因為天氣好。

items.exampleEn: Nobody knows the full extent of the damage yet.
items.exampleZh: 目前還沒有人知道損失的全部範圍。

items.exampleEn: The hall has a capacity of five hundred people.
items.exampleZh: 這個大廳可容納五百人。

items.exampleEn: The two rooms are equal in size.
The length of the movie is almost three hours.
items.exampleZh: 這部電影的長度將近三小時。

items.exampleEn: I'm not entirely sure about the date.
The two plans are totally different.

items.sentenceEn: This bag is the same length as that one.
items.sentenceZh: 這個袋子和那個一樣長。

items.audioEn: The meeting room is small. It has a capacity of only ten people.
items.audioZh: 會議室很小，只能容納十個人。
items.questionZh: 會議室可以容納幾個人？

items.sentenceEn: The report was written entirely by our new staff.
items.sentenceZh: 這份報告完全是由我們的新員工寫的。

items.sentenceEn: Men and women should have equal chances at work.
items.sentenceZh: 男性和女性在職場上應該有平等的機會。

items.stemEn: The movie was ____ different from the book; nothing was the same.
items.stemZh: 電影和原著完全不同，沒有一個地方一樣。

items.stemEn: To what ____ do you agree with this idea?
items.stemZh: 你在多大程度上同意這個想法？

items.passageEn: In our office, women are no longer a minority: half of the staff are women. Our manager believes everyone should have equal chances, and this change is largely due to her. To some extent, the office itself has changed too. The new meeting room has a capacity of thirty people, and its table is ten meters long. Some workers were not entirely happy at first, but now they say the office is much better.
items.passageZh: 在我們辦公室，女性不再是少數：一半的員工是女性。我們的經理認為每個人都應該有平等的機會，這個改變主要歸功於她。在某種程度上，辦公室本身也變了。新的會議室可以容納三十人，桌子長達十公尺。有些員工一開始並不完全滿意，但現在他們說辦公室好多了。

questions.questionZh: 這個改變主要歸功於誰？
新的會議室可以容納多少人？

items.promptZh: 我不完全同意這個看法。
referenceEn: I don't entirely agree with this idea.
I do not entirely agree with that opinion.
rubricZh: not entirely 表示「不完全」（部分否定）
entirely 例如放在 agree 前、句尾等位置

items.promptZh: 請把這張紙剪成四個相等的部分。
referenceEn: Please cut this paper into four equal parts.
Cut this piece of paper into four equal pieces, please.
rubricZh: 用 equal 表示「相等的」（例如 four equal parts、four equal pieces 等）
